card: Use case: illustration-story. Not a police officer, ranger or uniformed worker. At LEFT in medium-close waist-up view he looks thoughtfully and a little sadly toward a weathered wooden notice board at RIGHT. Show the BACK of the wooden board toward the viewer, so the writer can read its unseen front; NO visible writing at all. One EMPTY open wire litter basket nearby, with clearly empty interior. On the ground OUTSIDE it are a few pieces of paper, an empty bottle, an old tyre and rusty tins. A few woodland trees form a soft backdrop. This is only a close partial view of the littered woods, not a complete inventory: do not add any cars or refrigerators to this close-up. No cleaning or picking up, no rubbish bags, no culprit, police, arrest, punishment, cheering, victory or transformed tidy forest. Keep narrator's hands, face, hat, board and basket complete within safe 5% transparent margins, background fades into true transparency. Kind rounded storybook rendering, not frightening or disgustingly filthy. No readable text, labels, numbers, stars, awards or names.
